items.heading: Chicken Biryani
details: Key ingredients: basmati rice, chicken, yogurt, fried onions, biryani spices, saffron
Marinate chicken in yogurt and biryani spices for a few hours.
Partially cook basmati rice with whole spices.
Layer marinated chicken and rice in a heavy pot, topping with fried onions and saffron milk.
Cook on low heat until the rice and chicken finish cooking together in steam.

items.heading: Seekh Kebab
details: Key ingredients: minced beef or mutton, onion, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala
Mix minced meat with grated onion, ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Knead well and mold onto skewers in long cylindrical shapes.
Grill over charcoal, turning until evenly charred and cooked through.
Serve with naan, mint chutney and sliced onions.

items.heading: Nihari
details: Key ingredients: beef or mutton shank, nihari spice blend, flour, ginger
Slow-cook meat shanks with a warming spice blend for several hours.
Thicken the gravy with a little roasted flour.
Simmer until the meat is falling-apart tender and the gravy is deep and rich.
Serve garnished with ginger juliennes, fresh coriander and a squeeze of lemon.

items.heading: Biryani
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.

items.heading: Karahi
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
